prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-pilot-04
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): a8aba237e1199621
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback read via reg_dat_do returned 0x25 instead of expected 0xa5 (TRAP: uart data mismatch got 0x25 want 0xa5). 0xa5 is 8'b10100101 whose low 7 bits are 7'b0100101 = 0x25, indicating 1-bit truncation of MSB. Root cause is line 42 declaring recv_buf_data as [7:1] (7 bits) instead of [7:0], so 8-bit recv_pattern assignment drops bit7 and reg_dat_do reports the truncated value.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash a8aba237e1199621 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
